program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # input pair efficiency (near weak inversion)
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),       # input pair L
    "I1":    (80e-6, 50e-6, 100e-6), # current per input device
    "Ic":    (15e-6, 8e-6, 30e-6),   # cascode branch current
    "Lsrc":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # L of current sources / mirrors
    "gmid_c":(12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # cascode device gm/Id
    "Lc":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # cascode L
    "vmarg": (0.3, 0.2, 0.4),        # Vds target of current sources under cascodes
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-10)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I1, Ic = p["I1"], p["Ic"]
    Ip = I1 + Ic                  # PMOS source current
    It = 2 * I1                   # tail
    Ib1, Ib2, Ib3 = 10e-6, 5e-6, 5e-6
    gs, Ls = 9.0, p["Lsrc"]
    gc, Lc = p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"]
    vm = p["vmarg"]

    # ---- NMOS bias reference (ibias diode) and sinks ----
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, iref, vds=0.7)
    m0 = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, It, vds=0.4)              # tail
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, Ib1, vds=0.8)             # sinks pfet diode current
    mb2 = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, Ib2, vds=0.6)             # sinks vbpc branch

    # ---- input pair ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.9, vsb=0.4)

    # ---- PMOS current sources (top) + reference diode ----
    m3 = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Ip, vds=vm)
    mpb = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Ib1, vds=m3.vgs)
    mp3 = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Ib3, vds=0.8)             # sources vbn2 branch

    # ---- PMOS cascodes + bias diode (same density) ----
    m5 = lut.size("p", gc, Lc, Ic, vds=0.4, vsb=vm)
    mpc = lut.size("p", gc, Lc, Ib2, vds=m5.vgs, vsb=vm)
    Rp = vm / Ib2

    # ---- NMOS cascoded mirror (low-voltage) + bias diode ----
    m9 = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, Ic, vds=vm)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gc, Lc, Ic, vds=0.4, vsb=vm)
    mnc = lut.size("n", gc, Lc, Ib3, vds=m7.vgs, vsb=vm)
    Rn = vm / Ib3

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("M0", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("MB1", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPB", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MB2", "vbpc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.R("RP", "vdd", "spc", Rp)
    n.dev("MPC", "vbpc", "vbpc", "spc", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("MP3", "vbn2", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mp3)
    n.dev("MNC", "vbn2", "vbn2", "snc", "vss", mnc)
    n.R("RN", "snc", "vss", Rn)
    # input pair (vinp -> fa side, output taken from fb side => vinp non-inverting)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS sources
    n.dev("M3", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # PMOS cascodes
    n.dev("M5", "xa", "vbpc", "fa", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "vbpc", "fb", "vdd", m5)
    # NMOS cascode mirror (gates of bottom devices tied to xa)
    n.dev("M7", "xa", "vbn2", "ya", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "vbn2", "yb", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M9", "ya", "xa", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("M10", "yb", "xa", "vss", "vss", m9)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    ro_fold = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    r_up = (m5.gm + m5.gmbs) / m5.gds * ro_fold
    r_dn = (m7.gm + m7.gmbs) / m7.gds / m9.gds
    rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / r_up + 1.0 / r_dn)
    a0 = m1.gm * rout
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + m5.cdd + m7.cdd))
    c_fold = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg
    p_fold = (m5.gm + m5.gmbs) / (2 * PI * c_fold)
    c_mir = 2 * m9.cgg + m7.cdd + m5.cdd
    p_mir = m9.gm / (2 * PI * c_mir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_fold)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_mir)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_fold))  # half-path fold pole on mirror side
    itot = iref + Ib1 + Ib2 + Ib3 + 2 * Ip
    power = vdd * itot
    slew = min(It, 2 * Ic) / cl
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}

events.topology: Folded cascode (NMOS input, PMOS cascodes, low-voltage NMOS cascode mirror)
